pages.text: The Anti-Star Alliance is a black-market coalition opposed to the Star Palace, specializing in smuggling, intelligence, and pirate contacts. Its quest network is defined in inverse_star_quest_network.json.
pages.title: Anti-Star Alliance

pages.text: Its principal routes are recruitment through inverse_star_recruit, smuggling through inverse_star_smuggle_arc, and the Void Palace intelligence heist inverse_star_void_heist. These choices affect relations with the Star Palace.
pages.title: Alliance Routes
